description: This file defines the RemoteHostServiceHandle class, a subclass of ServiceHandle, representing a service running on a remote host with methods to get/set remote IP and identify its process and host type.

classes.name: RemoteHostServiceHandle
classes.description: A ServiceHandle implementation for services on remote hosts, including IP address management and process/host identification methods.

methods.name: RemoteHostServiceHandle
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service handle with name, IPC, event, optional visibility, and remote IP address.

methods.name: getRemoteIp
methods.description: Returns the remote IP address of the service.

methods.name: setRemoteIp
methods.description: Sets the remote IP address of the service.

methods.name: isSameProcess
methods.description: Indicates whether the service runs in the same process; always returns false.

methods.name: isLocalHost
methods.description: Indicates whether the service is on the local host; always returns false.

methods.name: isRemoteHost
methods.description: Indicates whether the service is on a remote host; always returns true.
